topic: Updating frequency SQL for analytics environment
summary_markdown: Someone requested assistance with migrating a frequency calculation used by Ocean Outdoor Denmark. The process requires aligning the code from `get_frequency.sql` (staging) to match the structure of `get_frequency_stage.sql` (production/analytics). [me] confirmed that this task is possible, provided there is read-only access to the database.
decisions: The frequency SQL needs updating to align staging and analytics environments.
action_items: Someone will update the frequency SQL script for Ocean Outdoor Denmark's analytics environment.
